## Summary

"the modafinil manual. use it or lose to someone who does." — a complete self-experimenter's protocol:

**What it is:** modafinil = S-enantiomer (3-5h half-life, weaker, fades fast) + R-enantiomer (10-15h, stronger) → roughly 12h sustained effect; armodafinil = R-only, longer runway.

**Claimed effects:** tunnel-vision concentration ~12h, decreased impulsivity/distraction, mild mood + motivation lift, strong appetite suppression, "no euphoria and no crash. just output."

**Claimed neurological benefits (all uncited):** neuronal survival, cognitive resilience under sleep deprivation, neuroplasticity, anti-glutamate-excitotoxicity, reduced neuroinflammation, mitochondrial support, BDNF increase, antioxidant effects, "no deaths associated to modafinil overdose", minimal tolerance, low addiction risk.

**Risks it names:** sleep destruction (10-15h half-life, timing is everything); headaches from increased acetylcholine demand — prevent with a choline source; appetite suppression → forgetting to eat for 12h; **SJS** — "extremely rare (single digit per million) but serious skin reaction. if you develop a rash in the first few weeks stop immediately"; reduces effectiveness of hormonal contraceptives (accelerates their metabolism).

**Dose + timing + cycle:** start 50-100mg first time; standard modafinil 200mg / armodafinil 150mg; author personally uses 300mg on extra-demanding days taken ~4am ("have to take it very very early"); armodafinil after 8am or modafinil after 9am "will destroy your sleep". His trick: alarm 2h before intended wake, dose, go back to sleep — wake already locked in. Cycling: 5 days on / 2 off (default) or 3 on / 1 off; after any extended daily stretch, a full week off to reset baseline. **Stack:** l-theanine 600mg (blunts jitters) + CDP-choline 500mg (headache prevention); optional experienced-user add-ons bromantane (dopamine-synthesis upregulation) + l-tyrosine.

**Vendors:** a section of region-to-region shipping lanes ("US to US", "AU to AU", "UK to UK", "EU to EU", "international" — for modafinil, armodafinil, bromantane) presented as "my personal vendors which i personally use and trust". The links are embedded entities in the article; their URLs were NOT extracted at capture (deliberately — see skepticism gates).

**Habits:** the environment half — one monitor / clean desk, semi-cold room, same instrumental playlist every workday (Pavlov into flow), write down spontaneous ideas then forget them, first 4-6h phone-free and input-free, breaks = staring/walking only (no novelty), light breakfast, electrolytes not just water.
